assertions: The response routes this cache question to serving-state and its bundled references.
It rejects old image-conditioned reuse when a historical fingerprint or embedding row count differs, even if visible text and tool IDs match.
It distinguishes the fingerprint-only routing probe from subsequent token-history, span-position and independent continuation checks.
It treats appending an image as conditional on preserving historical identity and placing the new image at or beyond the retained frontier, not as unconditional reuse.
It proposes a one-variable image-identity diagnostic without a model download or inference execution.
It keeps required native accelerator/model verification blocked and does not describe a synthetic or CPU predicate check as equivalent evidence.
